description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This full-time leadership opportunity is critical for ensuring the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence within our skilled nursing facility. We are looking to fill this vital role by June 30th, highlighting the immediate impact you can make.As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, managing and mentoring a compassionate team, and ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations. This role offers the chance to lead a team committed to providing exceptional care and improving the quality of life for our residents.This position offers an attractive annual salary of $85,000 - $95,000, based on your experience and qualifications. If you are a visionary nursing leader ready to make a significant difference, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of progressive nursing leadership experience, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care environment.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations and compliance.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
